fact: ICT service exports from Guinea were 0.0156 per cent of GDP in 2021, by the World Bank's series.
ICT service exports from Guinea were 0.0337 per cent of GDP in 2022, by the World Bank's series.
ICT service exports from Guinea were 0.3019 per cent of GDP in 2023, by the World Bank's series.
ICT service exports from Guinea were 0.1474 per cent of GDP in 2024, by the World Bank's series.

Prime Minister Amadou Oury Bah inaugurated Guinea's first laptop assembly unit at the Institut Superieur de Technologie in Mamou on 10 November 2024, built with China's Green View and local partner Guinea Technologie Innovation.

The IST Mamou director general says the institute's assembly unit, using parts from China's Green View, runs a production line averaging 500 computers a day and has an initial order for 2,500 computers.
